correctness.rationale: For the normalization over the algebraic closure, A=u^3-u and B=1+A^2 have simple disjoint roots, since A'=-1 and B' is nonzero at B=0. A simple root of A gives a totally ramified place and geometric connectedness; the orders 1,13,-81 are all coprime to 82. The ten tame totally ramified places give 2g-2=-164+10·81. At the finite branch places the differential valuations allow B^floor(13j/82) du/z^j with no further factors; at infinity v(u,z,du,B)=(-82,-81,-83,-492), giving precisely 0≤s≤j-2-6 floor(13j/82) for the monomial u^s. The forms are independent by the Kummer characters and the sum of their dimensions is 324, so they are a full basis. The inverse Frobenius on the characters is j↦55j mod 82. With 3j'-j=82t, z^(-j)=z^(-3j') c^t A^t B^(13t), and u is a separating parameter. Cartier takes the coefficients of exponent 3l+2 with cube roots. The c factor is a common nonzero block scalar; division of the raw output by the common B power preserves rank. The distinct target characters give a direct sum of images. An independently written, executed exact row-reduction replay counted dimension 324 and total rank 222, hence kernel dimension and geometric a-number 102.
residual_risks: The replay verifies the finite rank reduction given the basis and Cartier identities; the geometric justification is separate. No full torsion-group-scheme or other parameter claim is tested.
